name: e-invoicing-tr-tax-exemption-codes
title: UBL-TR tax exemption reason codes (e-Fatura)
description: The codes written to TaxExemptionReasonCode in Turkish e-documents (e-Fatura, e-Arşiv Fatura): VAT partial and full exemptions, the code for sales outside the VAT rate check, special consumption tax (ÖTV) and accommodation tax exemptions, special tax base (özel matrah) codes and export-registered sale codes, with their official Turkish descriptions.

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.8 TaxExemptionReasonCode), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-09

e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (TaxExemptionReasonCodeType, YatirimTesvikTaxExemptionReasonCodeType; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-05: used for schematron_status

fields.name: code
fields.description: Three-digit code written to cbc:TaxExemptionReasonCode. Keep leading zeros (001).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Description in Turkish as printed in the code list, usually starting with the article of the law (17/1 = KDV Kanunu article 17 paragraph 1). Line breaks of the PDF are joined; spelling is unchanged.

fields.name: list
fields.description: Code list in the guide: kdv_partial (Kısmi İstisna), kdv_full (Tam İstisna), other (Diğer İşlem Türü), otv (ÖTV İstisna), accommodation_tax (Konaklama Vergisi İstisna), special_base (Özel Matrah) or export_registered (İhraç Kayıtlı Satışlar ile DİİB ve Geçici Kabul Rejimi Kapsamındaki Satış).

fields.name: usage_note
fields.description: Usage note printed under the code in the guide (codes 151, 351 and 555). Empty for the others.

fields.name: schematron_status
fields.description: accepted when the code is in TaxExemptionReasonCodeType of the UBL-TR schematron; investment_incentive_only when the schematron accepts it only in investment incentive invoices (YatirimTesvikTaxExemptionReasonCodeType).
